TEST APPARATUS: The apparatus consists of weighing devices, glass graduates, specimen
molds, tamper, 200-ton "Shimadzu" universal testing machine.
TEST METHOD:
The "Condur SC" consists of two components namely the base component
(A), the hardener component (B) with mixing in the ratio of A:B= 4:1
by weight. After thoroughly mixed, the epoxy was cast in 2" standard cube.
After curing in the molds for 24 hours, they were removed from molds and
cured in room temperature until they reached the required test age.
The compressive strength of specimens at the age of 1 day are shown as follows.
